finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/preview.test.ts::the intentional commonmark deviation for a top-level `heading\n-` (single-dash setext h1... h2) is untested
evidence: The `isLoneDash` guard in list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts (~lines 100-112) is unconditional on nesting, so a top-level `Heading\n-` — which markdown-it previously rendered as `<h2>` — now falls through to paragraph + empty list, a real user-visible deviation. The only setext test added, preview.test.ts:181-186, renders `Heading\n---` (runLength 3), which takes the guard's false branch and therefore never pins the lone-dash outcome; no other test in the full file exercises a `=` or single-`-` underline outside a list. The PR's own todo doc even lists "top-level lone dash" as an intended test case with the unit-test step left unchecked, corroborating the gap. This is a coverage gap for a deliberate deviation rather than a functional defect, hence minor.
